Refactor completed.

What changed:
- Extracted tag request logic into [frontend/src/services/tagsApi.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/test_subject/exp-app-Javasript/frontend/src/services/tagsApi.js) so the endpoint and response normalization live in one place.
- Kept [frontend/src/services/getTags.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/test_subject/exp-app-Javasript/frontend/src/services/getTags.js) as a thin wrapper for compatibility.
- Switched [frontend/src/hooks/usePopularTags.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/test_subject/exp-app-Javasript/frontend/src/hooks/usePopularTags.js) to `AbortController` instead of a manual `isMounted` flag.
- Simplified [backend/routes/tags.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/test_subject/exp-app-Javasript/backend/routes/tags.js) by removing unnecessary async/try-catch around static JSON.
- Left the presentational component structure intact in [frontend/src/components/PopularTags/PopularTags.jsx](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/test_subject/exp-app-Javasript/frontend/src/components/PopularTags/PopularTags.jsx) and [frontend/src/components/PopularTags/TagButton.jsx](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/test_subject/exp-app-Javasript/frontend/src/components/PopularTags/TagButton.jsx).

Verification:
- Backend syntax checks passed with `node --check` on [backend/index.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/test_subject/exp-app-Javasript/backend/index.js) and [backend/routes/tags.js](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/test_subject/exp-app-Javasrcript/backend/routes/tags.js).

If you want another pass, the next useful refactor would be:
1. Collapse the tag service/hook into a single generic `useAsyncResource` pattern.
2. Add a small test around tag loading and error rendering.
3. Remove the remaining mock-data backend and make the API source-driven.
